title: Vikram and Betal: The Hardworking Girl

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a hardworking girl.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a girl who worked very hard.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: People laughed at the girl for working too much.
scenes.image_prompt: villagers laughing while girl works cartoon

scenes.text: The girl continued her work and studies.
scenes.image_prompt: girl studying and working happily cartoon

scenes.text: The girl became successful over time.
People praised her. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A hardworking girl achieved success despite others laughing at her. Vikram said hard work brings success.
